_comment: Folder C. Same job as Folder B's fragment -- declare the checks so the report can title them -- and merged the same way. The checks it declares are implemented as SHACL shapes rather than SPARQL CONSTRUCTs, which changes how they are referenced but not how they are declared.
_owner: Fleet Data Standards group -- the shapes half of the house rules

checks.title: Work order does not concern exactly one vehicle
checks.description: A work order must name exactly one vehicle: none and the work cannot be scheduled, more than one and the labour and parts cannot be costed against anything. Written as a SHACL shape rather than a SPARQL CONSTRUCT because cardinality is what SHACL says natively -- sh:minCount and sh:maxCount on one property path, against a target class.
checks.remediation: Split the work order into one per vehicle, or set :concerns to the single vehicle the work is on. If the work genuinely spans vehicles it is a programme, not a work order, and needs its own class.
checks.cucumber_scenario: Every work order concerns exactly one vehicle
